lines:
classDiagram
direction LR
class ThemeMode {
  <<enumeration>>
  System
  Light
  Dark
}
class AppearancePreferenceV1 {
  +ThemeMode mode
  +long version
}
class PlatformAppearance {
  +LightOrDark colorScheme
  +bool highContrast
  +bool reducedMotion
  +float fontScale
  +InputModality inputModality
}
class AppearanceProjection {
  +AppearancePreferenceV1 preference
  +long projectionSequence
  +bool stale
}
class EffectiveAppearance {
  +LightOrDark resolvedMode
  +bool highContrast
  +bool reducedMotion
  +float fontScale
  +InputModality inputModality
}
class DesktopTokenSet {
  +SemanticColors colors
  +TypographyTokens typography
  +SpacingTokens spacing
  +GeometryTokens geometry
  +MotionTokens motion
  +ElevationTokens elevation
}
class DesignSystem {
  +resolve(preference, platform) EffectiveAppearance
  +materialize(effective) DesktopTokenSet
  +applyBeforeReveal(tokens)
  +preview(mode)
  +restoreProjection()
}
class SettingsAppearanceController {
  +preview(mode)
  +commit(mode, expectedVersion)
  +showResolvedSystemMode()
}
class DesktopAppShell {
  +applyBeforeReveal(tokens)
  +placeDockedPanes()
  +collapseAtBreakpoints()
}
class FeatureView {
  <<interface>>
  +render(semanticRoles)
}
AppearancePreferenceV1 --> ThemeMode
AppearanceProjection *-- AppearancePreferenceV1
DesignSystem --> AppearanceProjection
DesignSystem --> PlatformAppearance
DesignSystem --> EffectiveAppearance
DesignSystem --> DesktopTokenSet
SettingsAppearanceController --> DesignSystem : local preview
SettingsAppearanceController ..> AppearancePreferenceV1 : typed update
DesktopAppShell --> DesignSystem
FeatureView --> DesignSystem : semantic primitives
note for DesktopTokenSet "Compact: spacing 2/4/6/8/12/16/24; rows 28; controls 24/28; radii 4/6/8"
note for DesignSystem "System follows OS; Light/Dark ignore OS scheme changes; no wrong-theme flash"

data.title: Desktop Appearance, Theme Resolution, and Compact Token Contract
